```{r setup}

library(tidyverse)

    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 0, 0, 0, unit = "pt"),
      legend.box.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 0, 0, 0, unit = "pt"),

```

## chromVAR top TFs

```{r chromvar_top_tfs}
plot_top_var_tfs <- function(var_df, n_top = 20, 
                             title_str = glue::glue("Top {n_top} TFs by variability in accessibility")) {
    top_tfs <- var_df %>%
      slice_max(order_by = variability, n = n_top) %>%
      arrange(desc(variability)) %>%
      mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
      arrange(variability)
    var_plot_top <- top_tfs %>%
      mutate(tf = factor(name, levels = top_tfs %>% pull(name))) %>%
      ggplot(aes(
        y = tf,
        x = variability,
        xmin = bootstrap_lower_bound,
        xmax = bootstrap_upper_bound
      )) +
      geom_pointrange() +
      labs(
        y = "",
        title = title_str
      ) +
      theme_bw()
    return(var_plot_top)
}
plot_top_var_tfs(variability)
```

## chromVAR on clusters separately

```{r chromvar_clusters}
# rm(list = Filter(function(x) {
#     str_detect(x, 'sovacool', negate = TRUE) &
#         str_detect(x, 'params', negate = TRUE)
# }, ls()))
load("output/chromvar_subset/chromVAR.c1.RData")
variability_c1 <- variability
load("output/chromvar_subset/chromVAR.c2.RData")
variability_c2 <- variability
load("output/chromvar_subset/chromVAR.c3.RData")
variability_c3 <- variability

var_df <- bind_rows(
    variability_c1 %>% mutate(cluster_id = 'c1'),
    variability_c2 %>% mutate(cluster_id = 'c2'),
    variability_c3 %>% mutate(cluster_id = 'c3')
)
var_plots <- c('c1','c2','c3') %>%
    map(\(x) var_df %>% filter(cluster_id == x) %>% plot_top_var_tfs(title = glue("{x} Top TFs")))
var_plots[[1]] + var_plots[[2]] + var_plots[[3]]
```


## clusterProfiler

```{r clusterProfiler, height='8in'}
load(params$clusterprofiler_rdata)

n_top <- 10
top_enrich <- enrich_results %>%
  group_by(cluster_id, ID) %>%
  summarize(max_gr = max(gene_ratio)) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = max_gr, n = n_top)
enrich_plot <- enrich_results %>%
  filter(ID %in% (top_enrich %>% pull(ID))) %>%
  mutate(name = fct_reorder(ID, .x = gene_ratio, .fun = max)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(gene_ratio, name, size = Count, color = cluster_id)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  labs(
    title = glue("Top {n_top} enriched GO terms in HE-HA genes"),
    y = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
print(enrich_plot)
```

Gene Ratio: genes of interest that match the GO term / total genes of interest

Count: genes of interest that match the GO term (i.e. numerator of Gene Ratio)

## Key TFs per cluster


```{r key TFs}
plot_heatmap_row <- function(dat, value_column = A_diff,
                             scale_fill = scale_fill_viridis_c) {
  dat %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      x = gene_name, y = 1, # y = diff,
      fill = {{ value_column }}
    )) +
    geom_tile() +
    facet_wrap(~cluster_id, nrow = 1, scales = "free") +
    labs(
      y = quo_name(enquo(value_column)),
      x = ""
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    )
}
top_tfs <- read_csv('assets/top_TFs.csv')

# plot TFs patchwork
(plot_heatmap_row(top_tfs, outdegree) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = 'viridis') +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())
) /
  (plot_heatmap_row(top_tfs, expression) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = 'inferno') +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_blank()
    )
  ) /
  (plot_heatmap_row(top_tfs, accessibility) +
       scale_fill_viridis_c(option = 'mako') +
    theme(strip.text = element_blank()))

```
